title: Порт парусных писем
description: A miniature stone sky-port with two brass mooring masts, cream-and-coral triangular sail awnings, a low ivory glider hangar on the north side and one tiny empty wooden sail skiff moored EAST. One cypress WEST, brass radio beacon near the hangar. A wide stone quay road curves gently past the hangar and around the mooring lawn, no square dock corners in the driving line.
